title.purpose: Title of the offer to add rekordbox tracks to the Library.
title.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel (when the Library already has tracks).

count_one.purpose: Says one rekordbox track isn't in the Library.
count_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, status when the whole collection is offered.
count_one.approved: {{count, number}} rekordbox track isn't in your Library

count_other.purpose: Says how many rekordbox tracks aren't in the Library.
count_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, status when the whole collection is offered.
count_other.approved: {{count, number}} rekordbox tracks aren't in your Library

countInPlaylists_one.purpose: Says one track in the chosen playlists isn't in the Library.
countInPlaylists_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, status after choosing playlists.
countInPlaylists_one.approved: {{count, number}} track in the chosen playlists isn't in your Library

countInPlaylists_other.purpose: Says how many tracks in the chosen playlists aren't in the Library.
countInPlaylists_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, status after choosing playlists.
countInPlaylists_other.approved: {{count, number}} tracks in the chosen playlists aren't in your Library

noneInPlaylists.purpose: Says the chosen playlists have nothing to add.
noneInPlaylists.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, status when the chosen playlists hold no new tracks.
noneInPlaylists.approved: No tracks to add in the chosen playlists

noPlaylistsChosen.purpose: Says no playlists are ticked yet.
noPlaylistsChosen.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, status after clicking Choose playlists and before ticking any.

add.purpose: Button that adds the offered tracks to the Library.
add.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, primary button.

choosePlaylists.purpose: Button that switches to picking playlists.
choosePlaylists.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, secondary button while the whole collection is offered.

wholeCollection.purpose: Button that goes back to offering the whole collection.
wholeCollection.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, secondary button while playlists are being chosen.

playlists.title.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, playlist picker heading.

playlists.empty.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, playlist picker when the export holds no playlists.

playlists.note.purpose: Says only tracks are added, not the playlists.
playlists.note.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, playlist picker, under its title.
playlists.note.approved: Only the tracks are added, not the playlists.

playlists.tracks_one.where: Playlist picker, beside each playlist that holds one track.

playlists.tracks_other.where: Playlist picker, beside each playlist that holds several tracks.

summary.added_one.purpose: Says one track was added to the Library.
summary.added_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding.
summary.added_one.approved: {{count, number}} track added to your Library

summary.added_other.purpose: Says how many tracks were added to the Library.
summary.added_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding.
summary.added_other.approved: {{count, number}} tracks added to your Library

summary.alreadyInLibrary_one.purpose: Says one of the offered tracks was already in the Library.
summary.alreadyInLibrary_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding, when above zero.

summary.alreadyInLibrary_other.purpose: Says how many of the offered tracks were already in the Library.
summary.alreadyInLibrary_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding, when above zero.

summary.waitingInMissing_one.purpose: Says one track waits in Missing because no file was found.
summary.waitingInMissing_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding, when above zero.
summary.waitingInMissing_one.approved: {{count, number}} waiting in Missing (no file found)

summary.waitingInMissing_other.purpose: Says how many tracks wait in Missing because no file was found.
summary.waitingInMissing_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding, when above zero.
summary.waitingInMissing_other.approved: {{count, number}} waiting in Missing (no file found)

summary.waitingForConfirmation_one.purpose: Says one track waits for its file match to be confirmed.
summary.waitingForConfirmation_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding, when above zero.
summary.waitingForConfirmation_one.approved: {{count, number}} waiting for a match to be confirmed

summary.waitingForConfirmation_other.purpose: Says how many tracks wait for their file match to be confirmed.
summary.waitingForConfirmation_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding, when above zero.
summary.waitingForConfirmation_other.approved: {{count, number}} waiting for a match to be confirmed

summary.undo.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding.

summary.done.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, summary after adding.

summary.undone.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, after an undo.

summary.cantUndo.purpose: Says the undo wasn't possible because the Library changed.
summary.cantUndo.where: Overview screen, rekordbox tracks panel, alert after an undo is refused.
summary.cantUndo.approved: Can't undo: the Library has changed since
